messages:
Aisha K: Quick ask — preparing launch post and webinar claims. Need a clean run we can cite: end-to-end latency and cost for chat and embedding flows on quantized/fp16. Can you run a 'cleanroom' bench and package artifacts?

Maya R: Yep. What exact cohorts/payloads and acceptance criteria?

Aisha K: Short list: 3 chat prompts (10, 256, 2k tokens), embedding batch sizes [1,8,64], quantized variants (4-bit,8-bit), fp16 baseline. Need p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost-per-1k and warm/cold start delta. Also provenance of samples. Deliverables: CSV + raw logs + minimal repro script.

Tom P: Also need the sample set to be deterministic; please seed RNG and commit a tarball of inputs we can archive. Could we include a small head-to-head of our tuning (batching, kv-cache) vs default?

Maya R: Yes — we'll run in staging on dedicated pool. Plan: 1) seed + artifact manifest 2) 3-run repeat with different seeds 3) warmup protocol: 100 requests at payloads to fill caches 4) collect perf traces and cost estimates. Est ETA 36h. Any embargo?

Aisha K: Prefer results by EOD Wed. Embargo until launch 2026-04-10. Important: marketing needs a one-paragraph conservative headline and an attachable CSV.

Devon: Heads-up: quantized 4-bit on long context (2k) may degrade quality; do you want eval outputs saved so PM can check quality?

Jules: I'll attach a small harness to push results to S3 under s3://redwood-marketing/benches/4850001234-cleanroom/ and produce manifest.json. Will also snapshot commit SHA.

Aisha K: Perfect. Also please show the exact CLI we ran for reproducibility. e.g. ```./bench_runner --model redwood-v1 --variant q4_0 --batch 8 --payload-file inputs.json``` 

benchmark-bot: Scheduled: bench-run 4850001234 started on staging-dedicated-2 at 2026-03-25T03:12:00Z

Maya R: Started warmup now. I'll post an interim note if anything blocks.
